# Saskia Silvhollow

Saskia Silvhollow currently serves as the Procurement Strategy Lead at Umbix Dynamics, an adaptive tutoring platform specializing in personalized learning pathways and mastery tracking for K-12 schools. Since joining Umbix in 2021, Saskia has focused on streamlining district-level acquisition processes, ensuring that schools can efficiently adopt cutting-edge educational technology.

Before Umbix, Saskia spent six years in educational technology procurement, most notably negotiating a pioneering multi-state contract for mastery tracking software licenses that enabled over 300 school districts to standardize their adaptive learning tools. This initiative, internally codenamed Project Pathfinder, reduced onboarding time by 40% and increased district adoption rates by 25%.

Saskia’s specialties include contract negotiation, cross-district procurement alignment, and optimizing purchase workflows to meet tight budget constraints. She is known for her methodical working style, combining data-driven decision making with close collaboration. At Umbix, she partners closely with product managers, district IT leads, and implementation teams to ensure seamless integration of new platforms within existing school infrastructures.

Current employer: [[companies/umbix-dynamics]].
